plain_summary_en: This paper studies The Evolution of Mainstream Media Clickbait on WeChat (2015–2024): A Longitudinal Analysis of Issue Distribution, Intermedia Homogenization, and Engagement Efficacy. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Mainstream, Journalism, Work (physics), Mass media. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
